data.name: Basarat
data.gender_notes: Basarat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who achieves success in life and is given blessings by Allah. The name Basarat carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Basarat usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's blessings and success in the spiritual journey of life
data.etymology: Basarat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basarat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: بصرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بصرة هي كلمة عربية تعني الفراسة والتفكير الصحيح، وهي مشتقة من الجذر ب ص ر، والذي يرتبط بالرؤية والفهم، وتستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سياق الرؤية والتعقل، وترمز إلى القدرة على رؤية الحق والjustice

in_urdu.name: بصارت
in_urdu.long_meaning: بصارت ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب صحيح فکر اور سمجھ بوجھ ہے، یہ لفظ جڑ ب ص ر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو دیکھنے اور سمجھنے سے متعلق ہے، اور اسے قرآن پاک میں دیکھنے اور سمجھنے کے سیاق و سباق میں استعمال کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: बसरत

in_pashto.name: بصارت
in_pashto.long_meaning: بصارت د عربی کلمة ده چې معنی یې صحيح فکر او समझ ده، دا کلمه د ب ص ر څخه اخیستل شوې ده، چې د لیدو او समझ کولو سره اړیکه لري، او د قرآن کریم په لیدو او rozum کولو په سیاق کې کارول شوی دی

in_english.name: Basarat
in_english.long_meaning: Basarat is an Arabic word meaning insight and correct thinking, derived from the root b-s-r, related to seeing and understanding, used in the Quran in the context of seeing and discernment, symbolizing the ability to see truth and justice

It is a name that signifies hope and optimism for a prosperous and fulfilling life. In many Muslim communities, the name is given to children as an inspiration for them to strive for success and to work hard towards their goals.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Basarat" lies in its root meaning, which is to be blessed by Allah. In Islamic teachings, the concept of blessing is deeply intertwined with the belief in God's mercy and compassion. The name "Basarat" is a reminder that all success and achievement come from Allah, and that we should be grateful for the blessings we receive in our lives. It is also a call to strive for spiritual growth and to seek Allah's favor through good deeds and righteous actions. Ultimately, the name "Basarat" inspires us to be thankful for the blessings we have been given and to work towards a life that pleases Allah.
